en.볼 베어링 실드 형식(OPEN·ZZ·DD)은 어떻게 다른가요?: What is the difference between ball bearing shield types (OPEN, ZZ, DD)?
en.<p><strong>OPEN(개방형)</strong> — 실드가 없습니다:
OPEN — No shield. Used where lubrication is managed directly.

Z/ZZ (metal shield) — Metal shield on one/both sides. Light rotation and good for high speed, but weaker against water and fine dust.

D/DD (rubber seal) — Rubber seal on one/both sides. Better protection against dust and water, with slightly higher rotational resistance.

Tell us the marking on your current bearing and we will match the same type.
en.일제 베어링의 DD(DDU)와 VV는 어떻게 다른가요?: What is the difference between DD (DDU) and VV on Japanese bearings?
en.<p>둘 다 양쪽 고무 실이지만 실이 닿는 방식이 다릅니다.</p><p>:
Both have rubber seals on both sides, but they differ in how the seal touches the ring.

DDU (NSK)·LLU (NTN) — Contact type. The seal lip touches the inner ring. Best protection against dust and water, but some rotational resistance and heat make it less suited to high speed.

VV (NSK)·LLB (NTN) — Non-contact type. The seal leaves a very narrow gap without touching the inner ring. Light rotation and good for high speed; dust protection is weaker than the contact type but better than metal shields (ZZ).

Tell us the marking on your current part number and we will recommend the same type.
en.메이커마다 실드 표기가 다른데 같은 형식인가요?: Manufacturers use different shield markings. Are they the same type?
en.<p>같은 형식을 메이커마다 다르게 표기합니다.</p><p><strong:
The same type is marked differently by each manufacturer.

Metal shields on both sides — ZZ (2Z for SKF)

Rubber seals on both sides — DD (Korean makers), DDU (NSK), LLU (NTN), 2RS (SKF, etc.), 2NSE (NACHI)

One side only — Z, D, DU, LU, RS, etc.

Details such as contact or non-contact design differ slightly by maker, so please give us your current part number and we will recommend the right product.
en.다른 메이커 제품으로 바꿔 써도 되나요?: Can I replace it with another manufacturer's product?
en.<p>같은 형번이면 국제 규격(ISO)에 따라 내경·외경·폭 같은 주요:
With the same part number, the main dimensions such as bore, outer diameter and width follow the ISO standard, so in most cases they are interchangeable.

However, precision class, internal clearance (C3, etc.), cage and grease specifications may differ. Let us know your machine and operating conditions and we will recommend the right product.

en.<p><strong>표기 없음</strong> — 실 없음 / <stro:
No marking — no seal / U — rubber seal on one side / UU — rubber seals on both sides

OP — Open type. One side of the body is open, for shafts with supports.

AJ — Adjustable type. A slit allows the clearance to be adjusted.

L — Long type with a longer body (e.g. LM20L)

e.g. LM20UU = 20 mm bore standard type with rubber seals on both sides

en.<p>기존 제품에 적힌 형식을 그대로 쓰시는 것이 가장 확실합니다. 형식:
Using the type marked on your current seal is the surest choice. Types are classified by structure.

TC — Rubber outer + dust lip + spring

SC — Rubber outer + single lip + spring

TB·SB — Same structure as TC·SC with a metal outer

VC·VB — No spring. Cannot be used where pressure is applied.

If you don't know the type, tell us the dimensions (bore, outer diameter, thickness) and where it is used. Our staff will check and advise.
en.<p>셋 다 먼지막이 립과 스프링이 있는 오일씰입니다. (NOK 카탈로그:
All three are oil seals with a dust lip and a spring. (Based on the NOK catalog)

TC — Rubber outer. Seals tightly against the housing and can also be used in aluminum housings. Pressure up to 0.03 MPa (0.3 kgf/cm²).

TB (metal outer) — Metal outer. Hard to dislodge with accurate positioning. Not suitable where pressure is applied or for housings that expand a lot with heat, such as aluminum.

TCV — Pressure-resistant type with a stiffer lip, for relatively small shafts at medium pressure, with a peak (surge) pressure of up to 0.3 MPa (3 kgf/cm²). For higher pressure, TCN (0.98 MPa) or TCZ (2.0 MPa) is used.
en.오링 P·G·S·V·AN 계열은 어떻게 다른가요?: What is the difference between P, G, S, V and AN series O-rings?
en.<p><strong>P계열</strong> — 운동용. 유압·공압 실린더:
P series — For moving (dynamic) parts, such as pistons and rods in hydraulic and pneumatic cylinders

G series — For fixed (static) parts, such as flanges and covers

S series — Small sizes with a thin cross-section

V series — For vacuum flanges, large sizes with a thick cross-section

AN series — US AS568 standard, common on American and European equipment.

P, G, S and V follow the Japanese JIS B 2401 standard. Tell us the series and number of your current O-ring (e.g. P20) and we will match the same size.
en.멈춤링 S형·R형·E형·C형은 어떻게 다른가요?: What is the difference between S, R, E and C type retaining rings?
en.<p><strong>S형(축용 C형)</strong> — 축 바깥 홈에:
S type (external C-ring) — Fits in a groove on the outside of a shaft to keep parts from moving off axially.

R type (internal C-ring) — Fits in a groove inside a bore to hold bearings and parts in the housing. S and R types are installed by expanding or compressing them with dedicated pliers.

E type (E-ring) — Pushed sideways into a shaft groove. It can be fitted without special tools, so it is widely used for small parts.

C type (crescent) — Fitted sideways like the E type, but its wider body withstands greater force.
en.멈춤링 호칭 번호(S-20, ETW-5 등)는 무엇을 뜻하나요?: What do retaining ring nominal numbers (S-20, ETW-5, etc.) mean?
en.<p><strong>S형</strong> — 끼우는 축의 지름 (S-20:
S type — Diameter of the shaft it fits (S-20 = 20 mm shaft)

R type — Diameter of the bore it fits (R-20 = 20 mm bore)

E type — Based on the groove diameter on the shaft, so it is smaller than the shaft diameter. (ETW-5 = 5 mm groove)

en.오링 재질(NBR·FKM 등)별 사용 온도는 어떻게 되나요?: What are the operating temperatures of each O-ring material (NBR, FKM, etc.)?
en.<p>NOK 오링 카탈로그 기준입니다. (괄호: 잠깐 견디는 최고 온도):
Based on the NOK O-ring catalog. (In parentheses: maximum short-term temperature)

NBR (nitrile, JIS Class 1A) — -24 to 100℃ (120℃). The most common basic material, for oil and grease

HNBR (hydrogenated nitrile) — -22 to 110℃ (130℃). More resistant to heat and oil than NBR

FKM (Viton, JIS Class 4D) — -16 to 200℃ (220℃). For high temperatures, fuels, synthetic oils and chemicals

EPDM — -49 to 130℃ (150℃). For water, steam and brake fluid; not for mineral oil

Silicone (VMQ) — -48 to 200℃ (220℃). Resistant to both high and low temperatures

Tell us the temperature and the fluid in contact and we will recommend the right material.
en.오일씰 립 재질별 사용 온도는 어떻게 되나요?: What are the operating temperatures of each oil seal lip material?
en.<p>NOK 오일씰 카탈로그 기준입니다.</p><p><strong>NBR:
Based on the NOK oil seal catalog.

NBR (nitrile) — -30 to 120℃. Standard material, for oil and grease

HNBR (hydrogenated nitrile) — -25 to 130℃. More resistant to heat and oil than NBR

ACM (acrylic) — -15 to 150℃. Resistant to oil and heat, weak against water

Silicone (VMQ) — -45 to 170℃. Resistant to high and low temperatures, weak against water and alkalis

FKM (Viton) — -15 to 200℃. Resistant to heat, oil and chemicals

The lip can get hotter than its surroundings due to rotational friction. Tell us the temperature and the type of oil and we will recommend the right material.
en.멈춤링 재질·경도·표면처리는 어떻게 되나요?: What are the material, hardness and surface finish of retaining rings?
en.<p>C형 멈춤링(S·R형 등) 당사 규격 기준입니다.</p><p><st:

en.축에 홈이 없어도 쓸 수 있는 멈춤링이 있나요?: Are there retaining rings that work on a shaft without a groove?
en.<p>네, 홈 가공 없이 쓰는 형식이 있습니다.</p><p><strong:
Yes, some types need no groove.

G type (grip ring, GTW) — Held in place by the ring's grip on the shaft. It can be fitted anywhere, but is not suited to strong axial forces.

K type (T5304) — Multiple spring claws bite into the shaft, so it withstands strong axial (thrust) forces.

Where high forces are involved, the surest choice is to cut a groove in the shaft and use an S or E type.

en.베어링 바깥에 끼우는 스냅링(NR형)은 어떻게 고르나요?: How do I choose a snap ring for the bearing outer ring (NR type)?
en.<p>NR형은 베어링 외륜에 홈이 있는 베어링(형번 끝에 N·NR이 붙은:
The NR type fits bearings with a groove in the outer ring (part numbers ending in N or NR) and holds the bearing axially in the housing.

en.WR·WS 동심형이나 U형은 일반 멈춤링과 무엇이 다른가요?: How do WR/WS concentric rings and U-type rings differ from standard retaining rings?

UC — Standard bore, fixed with set screws

en.<p>들어가는 베어링과 축 고정 방식이 다릅니다. 하우징 외형 치수 기준:
